data.name: AddPlant
data.comment: Title of the page for adding a plant, and the button that saves it.

data.name: EditPlant
data.comment: Title of the page for changing a plant.

data.name: AddingSeveral
data.comment: {0} and {1} are links, the texts of which are QuickAddLink and ImportLink.

data.name: NameHint
data.value: Give it a genus, a nickname, or both.

data.name: NumberHint
data.value: The number you write on the pot. Optional.

data.name: WishMarkGot
data.value: On your wishlist: mark it got

data.name: DiedBeforeOne
data.comment: {0} is a link to the plant, with the cause after it.

data.name: DiedBeforeSome
data.comment: {0} is links to the plants, separated by semicolons.

data.name: AddingAgain
data.value: Adding it again makes another one.

data.name: RaisedHelp
data.value: For a collector's number or locality, use Locality or code under the name.
data.comment: Locality or code is the name of a field on this page.

data.name: DateHint
data.value: If you only remember the month or the year, pick that rather than guessing a day.

data.name: DateFromPhotos
data.value: Set to the day of the oldest photo, so the photos come after it in the history.

data.name: SameDateAs
data.comment: {0} is the name of the plant copied, {1} the date.

data.name: ParentStillRooting
data.value: This is for a plant that already grows on its own. Still rooting? {0}, and pot it up when it's ready.
data.comment: {0} is a link, the text of which is ParentStillRootingLink.

data.name: LivesElsewhere
data.value: Not mine, it lives with someone else

data.name: LivesElsewhereNote
data.value: It stays out of your plant list and Today. Untick this when it becomes yours.

data.name: BackFromOutsideNote
data.value: Plants that spent time outside often bring pests in.

data.name: BackChecked
data.value: Checked it for pests, no signs

data.name: HumidityHelp
data.value: Low is a normal room, under about 40%. High is 60% or more, like a cabinet or next to a humidifier.

data.name: GrowsSummer
data.value: Grows in summer, rests in winter

data.name: GrowsWinter
data.value: Grows in winter, rests in summer

data.name: TrackTransitionNote
data.value: Adds a checklist to its page for washed roots, the first water root and the first new leaf.

data.name: OuterWaterTopic
data.value: keeping water in the outer pot
data.comment: Name of the subject of an information button.

data.name: OuterWater
data.value: Keep water in the outer pot

data.name: OuterWaterInfo
data.value: The outer pot holds water on purpose and the plant wicks it up, like a self-watering pot. Leave it off for an ordinary outer pot that you tip out after watering.

data.name: HowManyInPotHint
data.value: For pups or cuttings kept together in one pot

data.name: RemindNote
data.value: Today asks you to check it when it's probably dry, once it has seen a few waterings.

data.name: RemindNoteOff
data.value: Today asks you to check it when it's probably dry, once it has seen a few waterings. The reminder is turned on in Settings, and it's off there now.

data.name: WaterAtHelp
data.value: The moisture meter reading you water at, from 1 to 10. 3 is the top of the red dry part on most meters. Set it higher for a plant kept moister, like a peace lily.

data.name: WaterByHelp
data.value: Goes on the sheet for a plant-sitter. Not said means the way you pick for the sheet.
data.comment: Not said is the choice ListNotSaid.

data.name: FeedNone
data.value: Save a feed under Feeds first, then it can be given with the water here.

data.name: FeedHelp
data.value: Ticking Watered or Topped up also logs this feed and its doses.
data.comment: Watered and Topped up are names of kinds of care.

data.name: SitterNoteHelp
data.value: Goes on the sheet for whoever looks after your plants while you're away.

data.name: SpareHelp
data.value: Shows on the Available for swap page, which you can share as text.
data.comment: Available for swap is the name of a page.

data.name: QuarantineNote
data.value: Today says when it is time to check the plant and let it out.

data.name: QuarantineHelp
data.value: Kept apart from your other plants, e.g. while a new plant shows it has no pests.

data.name: AddOwnField
data.value: Add a field of your own

data.name: OwnFieldsHelp
data.value: Rename or remove fields under Settings, Your fields.

data.name: OfferText_One
data.value: Set {0} for {1} other plant of the same species too?
data.comment: {0} is what was set, {1} a number.

data.name: OfferText_Other
data.value: Set {0} for {1} other plants of the same species too?
data.comment: {0} is what was set, {1} a number.

data.name: FieldsEmpty
data.value: Add a field the app doesn't have

data.name: AboutHelp
data.value: For what stays true about the plant, like how it likes its water. Dated notes go on its history.

data.name: PhotosFromGallery
data.value: Pick photos of this plant from your gallery. Each one goes on its history on the day it was taken, and the newest becomes the cover.

data.name: PhotoCoverNote
data.value: The newest photo becomes the cover. You can add more later on the plant's page.
